title: Birth, Death and Diff: Insertion-Based Sequence Generation with Corrections
abstract: arXiv:2610.34310v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Insertion-based masked diffusion models enable flexible-length, parallel generation by interleaving mask insertion with token unmasking. However, because their generation decisions are irreversible, aggressive parallel decoding can introduce errors that subsequent steps cannot correct, necessitating conservative decoding with more forward passes (NFEs). Moreover, they exhibit higher entropy than standard MDMs because they marginalize over multiple alignments during training and therefore require even more conservative decoding in the absence of a correction mechanism. To address this limitation, we introduce ${\delta}$MDM, which makes intermediate generations revisable by equipping an insertion-based model with substitution and deletion operations. During training, we expose the model to errors caused by aggressive unmasking and insertion, teaching it to correct its own mistakes. At inference time, we interleave insertion and unmasking

translated_title: 生、死与扩散：基于插入的带纠正机制序列生成
translated_abstract: 基于插入的掩码扩散模型通过交替进行掩码插入与词元去掩码，实现了灵活长度、并行的序列生成。然而，由于其生成决策是不可逆的，激进的并行解码可能引入后续步骤无法纠正的错误，因此需要采用更保守的解码方式并进行更多次前向传播（NFEs）。此外，由于这类模型在训练过程中对多种对齐方式进行边缘化，它们比标准掩码扩散模型（MDM）表现出更高的熵，因而在缺乏纠正机制的情况下需要更加保守的解码。为解决这一局限，我们提出了 δMDM，通过为基于插入的模型配备替换和删除操作，使中间生成结果可以被修改。在训练过程中，我们让模型接触由激进去掩码和插入所引起的错误，教会它纠正自身的错误。在推理时，我们交替进行插入和去掩码操作……
tldr: 提出 δMDM 模型，通过为基于插入的掩码扩散模型引入替换与删除操作使中间生成结果可被修正，从而支持更激进的并行解码并减少推理所需的前向传播次数。
en_tdlr: Proposes δMDM, which augments insertion-based masked diffusion models with substitution and deletion operations to make intermediate generations revisable, enabling more aggressive parallel decoding with fewer forward passes.
